      "claim": "A parent reports the app is free and super easy to use for kids.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "We’ve been using this app for a few weeks now and I love it, especially for my daughter (4) who is learning her letters and sounds associated with them. Couldn’t believe it when I found out this one was free, and super easy to use for my kids."
